【外国人眼里中国烧炕取暖系统】
为什么这个人睡觉时床底下真的有火在烧……醒来却感觉无比舒适？🔥😴
这就是古老的中国炕取暖系统。火加热砖石砌成的床底下方的一系列通道。热量沿着平台扩散，即使火熄灭后也能保持数小时的温暖。
这种巧妙的设计无需加热整个房间，就能让睡眠区在寒冷的北方冬日里保持温暖。
没有电暖器，没有现代科技，只有几个世纪以来的工程智慧。🛏️🔥
#原来农村的柴火灶已经这么有型了#
Why does this man sleep with an actual fire burning beneath his bed… and wake up perfectly comfortable? 🔥😴
Meet the ancient Chinese kang heating system. Fire heats a network of channels beneath a raised bed made of brick or stone. The heat spreads through the platform and stays trapped for hours even after the fire goes out.
Instead of heating the entire room this clever design keeps the sleeping area warm through freezing northern Chinese winters.
No electric heater. No modern technology. Just centuries of engineering genius. 🛏️🔥
